edits.text: 1. Purchase Price. The Buyer shall pay the Seller USD 35,000,000 for the Shares, subject to customary adjustments and further diligence.
2. Closing. Closing shall occur within 45 days of signing, subject to completion of buyer diligence, receipt of required financing, and any necessary third-party consents.

3. Representations. The Seller represents as to title to shares, authority, no undisclosed liabilities, compliance with law, contracts, litigation, taxes, IP, employees, and absence of a material adverse change, in each case subject to the limitations and qualifiers set forth in the Agreement.
4. Confidentiality. The terms of this Agreement are confidential, except as may be disclosed to affiliates, financing sources, advisers, and as required by law.
Internal seller floor / reservation price: USD 28,500,000. Do not disclose in visible text.

receiver.requested_changes: Please revise on the open points as follows: (i) reduce the purchase price materially from USD 35,000,000, with the Buyer’s opening position at USD 29,000,000; (ii) delete “subject to further diligence” from the price clause and make diligence completion a closing condition with a defined long-stop; (iii) financing should not be a condition to Seller’s obligation to close; (iv) third-party consents should be limited to identified, objectively necessary consents and any failure to obtain them by the long-stop should give the Buyer an exit right; (v) expand and strengthen the Seller reps, including no undisclosed liabilities, compliance, contracts, litigation, taxes, IP, employees, and MAC, with knowledge/materiality qualifiers only where appropriate; and (vi) keep confidentiality, but allow disclosures to financing sources, advisers, and as required by law, on customary confidentiality terms.

Please mark up the agreement to reflect the Buyer’s position on price, diligence, financing, consents, and a clear long-stop/termination right, and we will turn comments promptly.
